horizon_driver: currency-confidence cycle — behavior resets on each FX/reserve-adequacy scare, roughly a 1-3 year horizon tied to the local devaluation/restructuring cycle

constraints.action: hold savings entirely in local currency through a visible devaluation episode
constraints.source: repeated regional precedent of household FX flight (Argentina, Turkey, Egypt)
constraints.breaks_under: credible, enforced capital controls plus a stable or appreciating currency sustained for 2+ years

stated_vs_revealed.stated: President Milei campaigned explicitly on formal dollarization of Argentina and shutting the central bank; the 2024-26 official narrative describes gradual 'currency competition' and normalization.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: Official dollarization was never implemented (a 50% peso devaluation was used instead in Dec 2023); FX controls were only gradually lifted through 2024-25; a 2025 tax amnesty was needed to draw an estimated ~US$20bn of previously undeclared household dollars ('mattress money') back into the formal financial system.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: The stated policy goal (full dollarization) was abandoned, while the underlying household behavior it was meant to address — large-scale private dollar-holding outside the formal system — is confirmed at scale by the amnesty's uptake.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: Turkish and Egyptian authorities have repeatedly announced de-dollarization or FX-stabilization programs (e.g., Turkey's lira-protected deposit scheme; Egypt's 2024 IMF-backed currency float and reform package).
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: Turkish household/business dollarization grew through the lira's >80% cumulative depreciation (2018-2023) and remained elevated into 2025; Egypt's pound fell ~37% in 2024, and remittances plus household dollar demand leaked into the black market ahead of the official devaluation (rate moving from ~E£30 to ~E£46/USD).
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Household dollarization is confirmed as a leading, not lagging, indicator relative to official currency policy in both cases — it moved before the official rate did.

tripwires.if: official FX reserve cover falls below roughly 3 months of imports, or a parallel-market FX premium exceeds ~20-30%
tripwires.then: household dollarization/black-market FX buying accelerates visibly before any official devaluation is announced — the fastest available early-warning signal per the Cartographer

tripwires.if: a credible stabilization program (tax amnesty, positive real rates, credible fiscal anchor) is enacted
tripwires.then: a meaningful but partial share of hoarded FX returns to the formal system within 12-18 months (Argentina 2024-25 precedent), not a full reversal

what_would_change_my_mind: A frontier/EM currency crisis in 2026-27 where household FX-buying/dollarization does NOT move ahead of the official rate or reserve data would break the 'fastest early-warning indicator' claim. This dossier extrapolates a general mechanism from three national case studies (Argentina, Turkey, Egypt) rather than a full cross-country panel, so treat magnitudes as illustrative, not precise.
